hooks.command: payload=$(cat); if root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" && [ -r "$root/.claude/hooks/guard-api-commands.ts" ] && command -v bun >/dev/null 2>&1; then if err=$(mktemp); then trap 'rm -f "$err"' EXIT; if decision=$(printf '%s' "$payload" | bun "$root/.claude/hooks/guard-api-commands.ts" 2>"$err"); then cat "$err" >&2; [ -z "$decision" ] || printf '%s\n' "$decision"; else echo 'guard-api-commands.ts: hook failed; allowing call.' >&2; fi; else echo 'guard-api-commands.ts: cannot capture diagnostics; allowing call.' >&2; fi; else echo 'guard-api-commands.ts: hook unavailable; allowing call.' >&2; fi; exit 0

if root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" && [ -f "$root/.claude/hooks/dev-server-status.ts" ] && command -v bun >/dev/null 2>&1; then bun "$root/.claude/hooks/dev-server-status.ts" 2>/dev/null || true; fi
